audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows contradicted their own why-text, and the entry rated a 50.12% lane at 8.5/10 difficulty while its diff token says EVEN and report[14] says 'Hard'.
audit.why: whys[0] says Riven wins Level 1 outright but the row said Heimerdinger; whys[1] says probe rather than commit (Skill) but the row said Heimerdinger; whys[3] says trade small or not at all (Heimerdinger) but the row said Skill; whys[5] says he controls the fight (Heimerdinger) but the row said Skill; whys[6] says side-lane him and cash the lead (Riven) but the row said Heimerdinger. The mirror flipped exactly these rows and the packet chart agrees.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 flipped as one atomic group across both layers with ratings to match; diffRating moved to 6/10 with breakdown.difficulty following, and tone moved to the EVEN colour the diff token already claims.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described as a stage Heimerdinger simply wins, with no number on UPGRADE!!!, and the ability was written 'UPGRADE!!' with two exclamation marks in three places.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! is 100 seconds at rank 1. That is the longest cooldown either champion has in lane and it is the entire reason Level 6 is contested rather than lost — after he spends it there is a very long window where the nest has no stun-amplifier behind it.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and spikes[2] rebuilt around the 100-second rank-1 cooldown with the Riot name spelled correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is named as the matchup-defining cooldown on every screen with no duration attached, and Hextech Affinity is never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: The grenade is a flat 11 seconds at every rank and costs 85 mana — a fixed, learnable timer, not a vague threat. And Hextech Affinity gives Heimerdinger move speed near his own turrets as well as allied towers, which is the reason chasing him into the nest fails even when his stun is down: he simply outruns you on his own ground. Both are the concrete facts a player needs and neither was on the page.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] and breakdown.difficulty now carry the 11-second grenade; whys[3] gives the 1325-unit rocket range against Riven's 275; spikes[2] names Hextech Affinity.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track CH-2 Grenade and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you dodge the 11s CH-2 Grenade and stay disciplined.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he cycles turrets faster than you can destroy them and W-pokes you back to half HP between your dash cooldowns — trade small or not at all.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he replaces turrets faster than you break them and Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units — you cannot answer from 275 — trade small or not at all.

edits.before: His UPGRADE!! grenade at Level 6 covers a huge area and stuns long enough for three turrets to unload — he wins any all-in you force without his R confirmed spent.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! turns CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade into a wide stun and three turrets unload — but it is 100s at rank 1, so an all-in after he spends it is even.

edits.before: Heimerdinger's UPGRADE!! on his turrets or grenade lets him 100-0 a diving Riven even under his own tower — never force a Level 6 all-in without his R on cooldown.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! on his grenade lets him 100-0 a diving Riven under tower, and Hextech Affinity speeds him up near turrets — never force 6 with his 100s R up.

edits.before: Land E-W stun before his CH-2 Grenade (E) stuns you — whoever lands CC first wins the short trade
edits.after: Land Ki Burst before CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — his is 11s flat, so one miss buys you a free window

notes: Agreeing with the mirror: the prose on this entry is otherwise at the quality bar, so the edits are deliberately narrow. Not asserted (the kits are silent): whether Valor's damage block absorbs turret beam damage, and whether Broken Wings' dash can carry Riven through the CH-2 grenade's travel. Left for a byte-exact pass, because they carry mojibake em dashes: report[14].t still reads 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10' after diffRating moved to 6/10, and the 'mid' paragraph still writes 'UPGRADE!!' with two exclamation marks. One more thing the tools will not catch: focus.text, the loading screen and every breakdown string abbreviate the ability as 'CH-2 Grenade', which is not its Riot name (CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade) — consistent across the entry, so I left it rather than fix it in three places out of ten.
